gaps_addressed: UAR retained-listener and truthful READY publication
KBD identity-safe nested legacy migration and durable daemon focus

candidates.name: Prometheus-AGS UAR retained listener plus oneshot readiness
candidates.fit_for_gap: Closes the port-release race and makes READY depend on completed runtime/application initialization.

evidence.claim: Current first-party source retains TcpListener and waits on a readiness oneshot before stdout READY.
The server accepts the retained listener and notifies readiness only after application construction.

risks: The GQAdonis sync branch diverges, so a broad cherry-pick may import unrelated production changes.
The repair is incomplete until GHCR publishes the exact merged SHA.
candidates.decision_rationale: This is the existing first-party 90% solution and uses only Tokio/Axum facilities already present.

candidates.name: Existing Prometheus signed KBD command and OpenRaft control plane
candidates.fit_for_gap: Already provides immutable identity, signed journal replay, authenticated typed REST commands, OpenRaft/redb commit, idempotency, and compatibility projections.

evidence.claim: Runtime owns immutable manifests, signed replay, legacy migration, and deterministic compatibility projections.
Control plane authenticates and commits typed envelopes through OpenRaft/redb.

risks: Legacy status parsing loses annotated completion.
Nested phase migration currently flattens parent relationships.
Service templates omit explicit project focus.
candidates.decision_rationale: Repair the three narrow integration defects; replacing the control plane would discard the already-correct safety machinery.

candidates.name: Immutable .prometheus/project.json manifest
candidates.fit_for_gap: Provides one stable routing UUID and repository fingerprint for BossFang worktrees once tracked with the repository.

evidence.claim: The manifest is the documented immutable project-identity boundary.

risks: The daemon still needs an explicit focus worktree for compatibility projections.
candidates.decision_rationale: Tracking the existing non-secret UUID manifest is simpler and safer than deriving or copying identities ad hoc per worktree.

build_required.need: Port retained listener/readiness channel to the GQAdonis sync branch and publish it
build_required.why_no_candidate: The candidate implementation exists first-party but must be adapted to the divergent release branch and its pipeline.

build_required.need: Correct annotated status and nested hierarchy migration plus durable service focus configuration
build_required.why_no_candidate: These are project-specific compatibility and installer defects inside the adopted KBD framework.
This is a local fixture drift correction, not a reusable library problem.
